about: V3's first live zone (Strategy's live-zone brief, phase 1), in the shape of V1's origins/zone-rows/zone7.row.json cut to what one player in one zone needs. Positions are metres in the zone's own frame (V1's: x east, z south; the same frame as the yard and pit below). `respawn`: where a dead hero stands again at full health after `downSeconds` of `died` (the 'You died' beat, V1 main.ts:1030). `areas`: rectangles (V1 safeAreas): `pvp` is the area's own flag, `spawnsAllowed` false keeps every spawn row out of it. `spawns`: one row per creature camp (live-zone phase 1b: three Pitborn stand at their own spots inside the Duel pit, the one place the page draws today, so that area allows spawns; each has its own respawnSeconds; aggro 2.5 m and leash 5 m, not V1's open-field 4 and 9.8, because the pit's play circle is 5.05 m across the Pitborn's arena, src/fight/play-radius.ts; Dom 2026-10-27 'space them about two times apart': the three stand at the corners of a triangle 6.92 m a side, the widest the 5.05 m circle holds with its 1 m edge row, the yard Pitborn at the north corner 6 m from where the newcomer stands, east and west 3.46 m from him; LEASH, Dom 2026-10-27 'it should be a free roam area' (a roll out of 5 m reset the fight): the leash is the BOSS's own distance from its spot, not the hero's, and must be at least the aggro plus respawn.json world.leashMargin (validated, src/zone/spawns.ts validateSpots), so a roll or a fight never trips it; a hero who runs off drags the boss until it lets go at the leash. 20 m. A kited boss that reaches another camp does not chain: that neighbour keeps its own aggro and leash); `kind` is an opponent profile id (today the opponent data/fight.json names; the difficulty profile rows replace it later); `respawnSeconds` is V1 spawn rows' own field; `roster` says the creature appears in the zone's roster listing; `behaviour`: aggro and leash are metres, roam is metres per second of wander, campSize is [min, max] creatures per camp (capped by src/fight/world-rules-defs.json campMax at spawn). The default zone id is data/zones/index.json. Spread: the yard Pitborn stays where it was (the opener's boss, 6 m from the newcomer); the east and west Pitborn stand out in the `field` spawn area, 14 m east and 13.6 m south-west of the centre of the Duel pit area, 16 to 24 m from each other (data/respawn.json world.spreadRadiusMetres is the extent spots may go to). Validated by src/sim/validate.js validateZone; read by src/zone/zone-rows.ts only.
